UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Registered TaskFlow user profile with role, approval status, and reward balance.

userId.description: The unique Firebase Auth UID of the user.

role.description: Role of the user in TaskFlow.

approvalStatus.description: Account approval status managed by admins.

balanceCents.description: Accumulated task reward balance in INR paise (100 paise = ₹1.00, read-only for regular users).

completedTasksCount.description: Total number of approved tasks for this user.

assignedTaskId.description: Optional ID of the primary highlighted task assigned to the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user registered (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

Task.title: Task
Task.description: A task created by an admin and visible to authenticated users, with app/website metadata, INR reward details, clickable HTTPS URL, step-by-step instructions, required proof details, mandatory text + photo proof submission, and review status.

title.description: Short descriptive title of the task.

appName.description: Name of the target mobile app or website.

appIconUrl.description: Optional app icon or preview image HTTPS URL or data URI.

description.description: Detailed overview and acceptance criteria for the task.

instructions.description: Step-by-step instructions explaining what the user must do.

requiredProof.description: Description of the exact written and screenshot proof required from the user.

taskLink.description: Validated HTTPS URL (e.g., Google Play Store or website link) for the task.

category.description: Task category label (e.g., App Install, Website Visit, QA Testing, Content Review).

rewardCents.description: Reward value in INR paise (100 paise = ₹1.00) upon approval.

assignedUserId.description: UID of the user to whom this task is assigned or who submitted proof.

assignedUserName.description: Display name of the assigned or submitting user.

assignedUserEmail.description: Email of the assigned or submitting user.

status.description: Current workflow status of the task.

proofText.description: Written text proof submitted by the user.

proofImageUrl.description: Firebase Storage HTTPS download URL or encoded image URI of the submitted proof screenshot/photo.

adminFeedback.description: Optional review feedback provided by an administrator.

createdBy.description: UID of the administrator who created the task.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the task was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the task was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

Submission.title: Submission
Submission.description: Mandatory text + photo task proof submission stored in the submissions collection.

taskId.description: ID of the task this submission fulfills.

appName.description: Optional app or website name associated with the task.

appIconUrl.description: Optional app icon or image URL associated with the task.

rewardCents.description: Reward value in INR paise associated with the task.

userId.description: UID of the user submitting the proof.

userName.description: Display name of the submitting user.

proofText.description: Mandatory written text proof submitted by the user.

proofImageUrl.description: Mandatory Firebase Storage HTTPS download URL or encoded image URI for the uploaded photo/screenshot.

proofStoragePath.description: Mandatory Firebase Storage reference path for the uploaded photo/screenshot.

adminFeedback.description: Optional review note from an administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the submission was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the submission was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

DemoWithdrawalRequest.title: DemoWithdrawalRequest
DemoWithdrawalRequest.description: Safe demo-only withdrawal request record without banking/UPI PII or balance deduction.

requestId.description: Unique ID of the demo withdrawal request.

userName.description: Display name of the requesting user.

amountCents.description: Requested demo withdrawal amount in INR paise (minimum 20000 = ₹200.00).

method.description: Selected payout method name only (no account numbers or UPI IDs stored).

status.description: Status marking this as a demo/pending request.

isDemo.description: Always true to indicate demo/request-only mode.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the demo request was submitted.
Server timestamp when the admin record was created.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores registered user profiles, balances, and account statuses.

/tasks/{taskId}.description: Stores tasks visible to authenticated users along with status, proof, and reward information.

/submissions/{submissionId}.description: Stores mandatory text + photo task proof submissions and their review statuses.

/withdrawal_requests/{requestId}.description: Stores safe demo-only withdrawal requests (without banking/UPI PII or balance deduction) for Admin Dashboard visibility.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Stores trusted administrator UIDs for role-based access control.
